model.name: efficientnet_b0
_options_name: segformer_b0 (Vision Transformer MiT-B0 + MLP decoder, 3.7M params, INT8 friendly)
segformer_b1 (Vision Transformer MiT-B1 + MLP decoder, 13.7M params, high mIoU)
segformer_b2 (Vision Transformer MiT-B2 + MLP decoder, 24.7M params)
fastvit_sa12 (Self-attention hybrid, 11.5M params, high aerial mIoU)

dataset._comment_test_size: Fraction of dataset reserved for final full-resolution testing
dataset._comment_val_size: Fraction of dataset reserved for validation (0.0 to disable)
dataset._comment_crops_per_image: Number of random crops sampled per training image per epoch
dataset._comment_val_stride: Validation sliding window stride (null = full stride = tile_size)
dataset._comment_test_stride: Testing sliding window stride (null = half stride = tile_size // 2)

training._comment_eval_every: Frequency in epochs to run full-resolution sliding-window validation

criterion.name: ce_dice
_options_name: fuzzy (LogitFuzzyLoss: membership + T-norm Dice + De Luca-Termini entropy)
ce (Cross Entropy Loss with optional label smoothing)
criterion._comment_ignore_index: Class index excluded from loss and metrics (5 = Unlabeled)
